What is the purpose or Function of Representation?

In some sense, Representation is an Interpretation of information, presenting or projecting a specific view which affords a Class of Information.

In other words, Representations are Lenses which make specific things visible, while occluding or removing other kinds of information entlrey.

Examples

In mathematics, the Graph was the first representation, showing visual. however, this merely a visual representation, abstraction affords different kinds of representations.
